The yellow centre paint of the Lake Murray north roads, MEASURED off public-domain NAIP (ledger 0054, P3 repair
round 2). Written by tools/aerial_paint_north.py; read by tools/author_expansion.py (paint_measured).
frame: the intermediate's stations (data/expansion.north.json pieces[].stations); offsets + = left of the J-order direction
imagery: USGS, USDA, The National Map: Orthoimagery (NAIP; public domain), EPSG:3857, TLS verified
